title: Oven Smoky Peruvian Cabbage Arroz Con Pato
description: A smoky and light Peruvian dish featuring cabbage leaves and a dairy-free friendly mother sauce base, served in the style of arroz con pato. This energizing meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the smoked paprika, aji amarillo pepper, and cabbage leaves, and cook for 2 minutes, until the cabbage starts to wilt.
Add the uncooked white rice and cook for 1 minute, until the rice is coated in the spice mixture.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
While the rice is baking, season the duck breast with salt and pepper, and sear in a hot skillet until browned on all sides.
Let the duck rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving on top of the arroz con pato.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
